consequence.statement: New certificate issuance and expiration time metrics are exposed. Nothing existing breaks or changes.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds two certificate metrics, certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds, with no operator action required.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The subject is a pair of new Prometheus metrics (certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds, certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds). No subject family covers metric names, and the change names two of them.; applicability: This is an additive feature. The evidence names no configuration condition that exposes an environment, and the metrics are added unconditionally.
